Risk Disclaimer

Effective: January 1, 2025 | Read carefully before proceeding

warning

Important Risk Warning

Alternative Investment Funds carry significant risks including potential total loss of capital. They are suitable only for sophisticated investors who can withstand illiquidity and accept high investment risk. Do not invest money you cannot afford to lose entirely.

1. General Investment Risks

All investments carry risk. The value of investments in Alternative Investment Funds can decrease as well as increase. You may receive less than you invested. Past performance data presented on this platform is historical and is not a reliable indicator of future performance or results.

2. Liquidity Risk

AIFs are primarily illiquid instruments. Category I and II AIFs must be close-ended, with a regulatory minimum tenure of three years and no regulatory maximum; stated tenures of seven to ten years are common in private equity, venture capital, real estate and infrastructure strategies. Tenure may be extended by up to two years with the approval of two-thirds of unit holders by value, or up to five years for a fund open only to accredited investors, and a one-year liquidation period follows expiry. Early exit is generally unavailable or subject to significant penalties. You should only invest capital you can commit for the full stated tenure together with any extension and the liquidation period.

3. Concentration Risk

Unlike mutual funds, AIF portfolios may be concentrated in a small number of companies, sectors, or geographies. A single adverse event affecting a portfolio company can materially impact overall fund returns.

4. Leverage Risk (Category III)

Category III AIFs may use leverage through derivatives. Leverage amplifies both gains and losses. In adverse market conditions, leveraged funds can lose significantly more than 100% of invested NAV if leverage ratios are not properly managed. SEBI prescribes leverage limits which funds must adhere to.

5. Regulatory & Tax Risk

Tax treatment of AIF investments may change. Budget amendments, SEBI regulatory changes, or judicial rulings may affect the tax efficiency of your investment. Category III AIF investors are taxed at Maximum Marginal Rate at the fund level. Seek independent tax advice before investing.

6. Manager & Operational Risk

Returns depend materially on the skill and judgment of the Fund Manager. Key person departure, operational failures, or conflicts of interest may adversely impact fund performance. Conduct independent due diligence on the fund manager's track record, team stability, and operational infrastructure before committing capital.

7. Not Investment Advice

Nothing on Platizio Alternatives platform constitutes personalized investment advice. Platizio Alternatives is not a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser under the IA Regulations. Before investing, consult a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser, your tax consultant, and legal advisor to assess suitability for your specific financial situation.
